errorCodes.meaning: The request did not arrive on a mux connection, so there is no session attach it could remove. Send it on the connection that holds the attaches.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

MuxDid.description: A DID, carried verbatim and compared by exact string equality. Unlike the messaging family's `Vid`, never a hash: the mediator resolves it to verify a statement signed by it. For a member DID reached over TSP, the TSP VID is the DID itself.
MuxDid.title: MuxDid

Response.description: The success response to a messaging/mux/detach request: every requested DID appears in `detached` or `notAttached`. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/messaging/mux/detach/0.1#response.

detached.description: DIDs whose session attach was removed. Each has left the connection, unless it is also listed in `retainedByGrant`.

notAttached.description: DIDs that had no session attach on this connection. Nothing changed for them.

retainedByGrant.description: DIDs that are also members through a stored grant: their session attach was removed, and they stay on the connection under the grant's scope. Revoke the grant with messaging/mux/revoke to remove them.

Response.title: Messaging — Mux Detach — response payload

schema.description: A principal removes session attaches from the connection that carries the request. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

dids.description: The member DIDs whose session attaches on this connection are removed. A DID appears at most once.
